items.name: money
items.title: Money helpers
items.description: Decimal-safe parsing, formatting and minor-unit conversion for money, built on Intl and BigInt.
items.author: Aran Shayan <https://aranshayan.com>

items.name: money-input
items.title: Money Input
items.description: A money field that groups as you type, keeps the caret in place, never rounds, and returns a decimal string.
items.author: Aran Shayan <https://aranshayan.com>

items.name: approval
items.title: Approval rules
items.description: Maker-checker rules as plain functions: no self-approval, distinct approvers, role checks and exact amount thresholds. Run them on the server too.
items.author: Aran Shayan <https://aranshayan.com>

items.name: audit-timeline
items.title: Audit Timeline
items.description: Who did what and when, grouped by day in any time zone, with field-level before and after values.
items.author: Aran Shayan <https://aranshayan.com>

items.name: maker-checker
items.title: Maker-checker
items.description: Request, review and approve a change with a second pair of eyes. Shows progress, what would change, and a reason when the viewer cannot act.
items.author: Aran Shayan <https://aranshayan.com>
